title: Coefficient-presentation scalar lift normalized on representatives
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime l≠D.p and an algebraic closure Ω of Q_l. Let T be noetherian, finite dimensional, with l invertible in every stalk. For any finite coefficient subfields A⊆B of Ω, there exist a generator-normalized ordinary scalar transport o of [def-fd-coefficient-comparison-datum] and an integral natural isomorphism a from integralDetailedTransport followed by PBC ambient ordinary extension to framework strict scalar extension followed by integralDetailedTransport, both restricted to sfIntegralConstructible. On every flat-term K-flat complex P whose localization is integral constructible, a followed by the strict scalar resolving comparison and target coefficient factor equals the source coefficient factor followed by the PBC ordinary tensor counit and Q(o.completion(P)). Here o.completion is the inverse ordinary tensor transport followed by the actual quotient-map completedScalarChainComparison, including zero shifted-product coordinate. All maps are the retained functors and factors of [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison, def-pur-completed-coefficient-presentation-transport]. This asserts neither exactness nor restricted shift compatibility.

proof.text: The coefficient-presentation isomorphisms commute with finite projections. Therefore their scalar square commutes after taking limits. Apply the ordinary balanced-tensor comparison, with inverse coefficient identifications, to construct o. Its hom sends the tensor of s and x to the tensor of e_B inverse(s) and x. Inverse identification makes both composites identities on generators; generation after sheafification proves invertibility.

Derive this ordinary comparison by the canonical tensor counits. Its presentation inverse is the coefficient-presentation scalar comparison. On the constructible source compose with coefficient transport of completedScalarComparison. Completeness of the input makes that comparison invertible; strict extension preserves constructibility. This gives a.

Evaluate on P. Substitute the ordinary transport counit square and the localization equation for the actual completedScalarComparison. Use naturality of fdCoefficientTransportFactors to move the strict resolving map through coefficient transport. The two inverse ordinary comparisons cancel, leaving Q of the inverse termwise transport followed by completedScalarChainComparison, exactly o.completion. The canonical comparisons establish independence of representatives. Quotient and zero coordinates are retained by composition.

theorem fdCoefficientScalarLift_normalization
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{d}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (Ω : Type w) [Field Ω] [Algebra ℚ_[l] Ω] [IsAlgClosure ℚ_[l] Ω]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T]
    [dT : Fact (∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim T ≤ n)]
    [iT : Fact (∀ t : T, IsUnit (l : T.presheaf.stalk t))] :
    ∀ {A B : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω} (h : A ≤ B),
      ∃ (o : FdOrdinaryScalarTransport l Ω T h)
        (a : (sfIntegralConstructible l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω A) T).ι ⋙
          integralDetailedTransport T l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω A) ⋙
            pbcAmbientScalarExtension l Ω T h ≅
        sfConstructibleIntegralScalarExtension D.p l hl (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω A)
          (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω B) (pbcFiniteFieldInclusion l Ω h) T ⋙
          (sfIntegralConstructible l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω B) T).ι ⋙
            integralDetailedTransport T l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω B)),
      ∀ (P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω A) T).FullSubcategory)
        (hP : sfIntegralConstructible l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω A) T
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj)),
      HEq (a.hom.app ⟨DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj, hP⟩ ≫
        (integralDetailedTransport T l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω B)).map
          ((integralScalarExtensionComparison l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω A)
            (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω B) (pbcFiniteFieldInclusion l Ω h) T).hom.app P) ≫
        (fdCoefficientTransportFactors l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω B) T).hom.app
          ((integralScalarComplexFunctor l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω A)
            (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω B) (pbcFiniteFieldInclusion l Ω h) T).obj P.obj))
        ((pbcAmbientScalarExtension l Ω T h).map
          ((fdCoefficientTransportFactors l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω A) T).hom.app P.obj) ≫
        pbcComplexCounit (pbcCompletedScalarMap l Ω T h)
          (((fdCoefficientTransport l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω A) T).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).obj P.obj) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (o.completion l Ω P.obj))
